newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van der Horst rises on pipeline deal.
newsitem.headline: Van der Horst rises on pipeline deal.

text.p: Van der Horst Ltd shares rose early Tuesday by almost 10 percent to Singapore $2.58 on news that it clinched a pipeline project in Indonesia.
After half an hour of trading, the stock was up 21 cents to S$2.56. Volume was 1.66 million units.
The infrastructure-based company said on Monday it had been awarded the pipeline project in Bali for US$72.5 million.
"It is good news for the company but some people are still skeptical about them," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
The company's shares have been under some selling pressure after it posted an 84-percent plunge in its interim profits in June.
